subject: CloudCon 2027 — sponsor booth content and on-stand script
messages:
From: Sofia Mendez <sofia@brightstage.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightStage Events <events@brightstage.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudCon 2027 — sponsor pack & booth content

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a CloudCon 2027 sponsor. A few logistical asks from our side as we build the sponsor hub: can you provide a short on-stand script (30–45s) for booth staff, a one-pager we can link from our app and hand out to visitors, and a looping slide (1920x1080) that will run on your monitor?

Key deadlines: we need the slide and final one-pager by Aug 24 so we can add it to the sponsor playlist; the on-stand script can be a working draft by Aug 21. AV team also asked for any higher-framerate assets if you plan motion.

I attached the sponsorship guidelines and the event AV specs, which include booth size options and AV port information.

Attachments: Sponsorship_Guidelines.pdf (PDF), CloudCon_AV_Specs.xlsx (XLSX)

Also: can you confirm the primary demo flow you want running on the booth machine (live convo, pre-recorded demo, or both)? We can coordinate exact timing.

Looking forward — Sofia

Sofia Mendez
Partnerships Manager, BrightStage Events
sofia@brightstage.com | +1 415-555-0123
https://brightstage.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Mendez <sofia@brightstage.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon 2027 — sponsor pack & booth content

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the attachments. Confirming we’ll deliver:
- 30–45s on-stand script for booth staff (working draft by 21 Aug, final by 24 Aug)
- One-pager PDF + print-ready handout (final by 24 Aug)
- 1920x1080 looping slide (MP4 or static PNG) by 24 Aug

For the demo flow: we'd like to run a short pre-recorded 90s demo loop with the option for staff to trigger a live 3–4 minute walk-through for qualifying prospects. Please confirm if the booth AV can run a looping MP4 at 30fps and whether there’s HDMI + network access.

I’m copying our internal leads on assets and timelines and will run a quick triage call tomorrow to assign owners.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: CloudCon sponsor deliverables — quick triage (internal)

Team — forwarding BrightStage’s ask. TL;DR: slide + one-pager final by 24 Aug; on-stand script draft by 21 Aug.

Concrete asks:
- Ben: can you draft the demo narrative and 90s pre-recorded demo script? Focus on a crisp value statement, 3 customer pain points we solve, and a live demo cue to trigger a KV-cache visual. Due EOD Aug 20 (so we can iterate).
- Tessa: you own the looping slide. We need one static + one MP4 loop (15–30s) for the monitor. Include 2 lines of product callouts and a CTA to our booth QR. Due Aug 23 for review.
- Rishi: one-pager (single page, printable + PDF) — include 2 quick case stats, pricing hint ("contact sales"), and a tiny architecture callout for platform buyers. Put rough draft in the Drive folder; I added a link to BrightStage’s specs. Due Aug 22.

Other notes: keep all assets brand-aligned (attached brand kit in Drive). Use customer quote from OmniShop case study (we can paraphrase) — ask sales for permission if needed.

Let me know if any timeline clashes. We’ll have a 30-minute review on Aug 24 with BrightStage (time TBC).

Thanks — Lauren
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon sponsor deliverables — quick triage (internal)

On Mon, Aug 16, 2027 at 08:22 Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding BrightStage’s ask. TL;DR: slide + one-pager final by 24 Aug; on-stand script draft by 21 Aug.

I can take the demo narrative and will drop a first pass into the Drive by EOD Aug 19. Planning to do a 3-part flow: 1) problem/context (10s), 2) 90s demo highlights (60s), 3) call-to-action + qualification cue (20s).

Tessa — happy to sync on frame and transitions if you want a timed MP4. Rishi — I’ll pull the OmniShop stat into the doc but will flag for legal/sales sign-off.

— Ben
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon sponsor deliverables — quick triage (internal)

On Mon, Aug 16, 2027 at 08:22 Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding BrightStage’s ask. TL;DR: slide + one-pager final by 24 Aug; on-stand script draft by 21 Aug.

Quick update: I’ve created a draft slide loop (15s MP4) and uploaded it to Drive (link in folder). It uses the motion card treatment from our brand kit and includes the booth QR CTA. Ben — I timed the demo markers; drop me any changes and I’ll update the timing. Rishi — can you confirm the two case stats you want on the one-pager this afternoon?

I’ll be available for a 30-minute review late Wednesday (Aug 24) — propose 10:00 AM PT for the sync with BrightStage.

— Tessa
